key_highlights: Nasdaq rebounds after a sharp sell‑off but tech stocks remain under pressure
US labor market shows resilience with 165k jobs added in October
Oil prices dip below $100 on hopes for an end to the Iran conflict
Copper demand spikes in Asia amid Chinese supply constraints
AI funding continues at scale despite market skepticism
Gold prices extend declines following strong US employment data
Data‑center loan market faces a $500M distressed sale, raising credit concerns
Geopolitical sanctions on Canadian firms and Chinese companies heighten risk

market_outlook.short_term: 1‑3 months: Elevated volatility as midterm election outcomes settle and AI valuation corrections continue. Expect tech indices to underperform, while energy and commodity‑linked assets may see modest upside.
market_outlook.long_term: 6‑12 months: Potential stabilization of tech valuations if AI products mature; gradual recovery in global growth supporting copper and industrial metals; oil price trajectory tied to geopolitical developments. Overall market likely to trend neutral to mildly positive pending policy clarity.

China’s copper supply response and industrial demand data
Oil supply dynamics and any escalation/de‑escalation of Iran conflict
Regulatory developments around AI and crypto reporting (FinCEN withdrawal)
